reason: Introduce independent decision/evidence tests and enforce exact-run quality admission, source-bound policy reasoning, reproducible scheduled exploration, retained measurements and read-only health monitoring, as requested by the repository owner.
risk: The new required check may block merges for real regressions or unavailable scanner setup. Infrastructure failures remain explicit. Trend calibration starts with real hosted measurements; fixed limits and reviewed mutation equivalence are not automatically relaxed.
validation: Local negative admission, policy, trend and monitor regressions; real recovery runner smoke; native actionlint and documentation/guidance checks. All applicable hosted PR checks must pass before merge. The initial testing delivery record retains the measured full-suite, mutation, scanner and history evidence.
coverage_impact: Replace three self-comparison validator properties with independent positive/negative expectations and focused evidence mutations. Retire only the obsolete mutmut shell-command assertion. Add decision, stateful, recovery and history coverage; preserve existing UI, package and release checks. Governance test fixtures contain skip markers solely to test scope review. New public decision functions and modules require an explicit coverage decision.
